description: This file declares the interface for WTC RBUS APIs related to stats and parameter handling in a Wi-Fi test controller component. It includes function prototypes for initializing RBUS, parameter validation, value retrieval, and setting, as well as some utility functions.

methods.name: WTC_RbusInit
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS interface for WTC.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter name from a given path.

methods.name: CheckIfValidDscp
methods.description: Checks if the provided string represents a valid DSCP value.

methods.name: IsDigit
methods.description: Checks if the string consists solely of digits.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets the string value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets the unsigned long value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the string value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: Stats_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets the unsigned long value of a specified parameter.
